**H1-2b: VCS port widening (headRefOid + prStatusRollup) + cold-boot fetchHead seam retirement**

**What**: Implemented ADR-0021 Decision 1-3 (Track H, issue #266) in worktree `/home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-266-h1-2b`, branch `feat/issue-266-h1-2b-port-widen-seam-retire`: (1) widened `prView` on both VCS providers to return `headRefOid` (github: added to `gh pr view --json` field list; gitlab: MR payload `sha` falling back to `diff_refs.head_sha`; uncomputable path returns `headRefOid: null`); (2) added new READ verb `prStatusRollup({project, number})` normalized to `[{name, status, conclusion}]` on both providers (github: `gh pr view --json statusCheckRollup`; gitlab: resolves MR head sha then `GET .../repository/commits/:sha/statuses`, `conclusion` always null since GitLab has no separate field), registered in `cli.mjs` VERBS and `vcs-contract.md` required-verbs table (doctrine-sync mandated by Accepted ADR-0021 — the only allowed brain/core edit); (3) retired the H1-1 cold-boot `fetchHead`/`defaultFetchHead` DI-seam reader from `cold-boot.mjs` — `gatherColdBoot` now reads `headSha` from `prView.headRefOid` (the same fetch already made for the self-review check), no separate seam.

**Why**: Fork A condition 2 (issue #266 comment 4993202904) bound the interim H1-1 reader's retirement to this widening "so it never calcifies into a parallel mini-port." ADR-0021 (Accepted) is the authority.

**Where**: `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/github.mjs`, `gitlab.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/cli.mjs` (VERBS), `brain/core/methodology/vcs-contract.md`, `brain/scripts/vcs/providers/vcs.contract.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/vcs/providers.test.mjs`, `brain/scripts/review/cold-boot.mjs`, `cold-boot.test.mjs`, `cli.test.mjs`, `openspec/changes/issue-266-h1-brain-review/tasks.md` (new Phase 6b, checked off).

**Learned**: Strict TDD RED-guard: a source-scan test asserting "no fetchHead reference remains" via `assert.doesNotMatch(src, /fetchHead/i, ...)` will also trip on the file's OWN prose comments/JSDoc mentioning the retired name historically — had to reword comments to avoid the literal identifier while still documenting the history. Final counted diff (production only, `*.test.mjs` free): 181 lines via `git diff --numstat origin/issue-266...HEAD | node brain/scripts/vcs/diff-size-count.mjs` — under the 400 budget, no exception needed. Full suite: 1518/1518 green (up from 1504 baseline). 5 commits in small conventional units (2 test(vcs)/test(review), 2 feat/refactor, 1 docs). Did NOT push or open a PR per instructions (task 6b.4 left unchecked for the human to open).
